risk_note: B1-03zn (orchestrator 21:27, B1-03zl Codex money r2 out_of_scope): the console registration of an order appeal (admin-appeals-write.ts register) now follows the user submission. appeals.ts exports lockOrderAppeals (the same pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('risk.appeals.order:<app>:<order>', 0)) that submitOrder used inline; submitOrder now calls it) and orderAppealAttemptsLeft (the order's count = every appeal on that order in the app, any status incl. revoked, user and console alike; 3 → refused). register for an order target: lock → processing appeal returned → count → insert, on one transaction. Account and blocked_request counting and locking unchanged; user submission behaviour unchanged; audit as before (appeal_register). Rule tests by an independent Claude in two attempts (r1 spec-test S1: the lock fixture inserted a closed third appeal, so 'processing read before the lock' would pass; attempt 2 adds a processing-holder case); red 17 tests for the right reason. Implementation by Opus 5.5 in one round; container rule tests 17/17 green. No migration, no contract change. Written by hand.
